items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Are you still keeping very active studio time or your kind of being more selective?
I would not characterize it as very active studio time. I mean the studio is up to snuff, you know technically. I think its every bit as good as it ever was. You know Don is working here…

But there’s less—you know the industry has changed so drastically. There’s less work, there’s less recording going on by far. Many of the major studios that used to exist in New York are gone. Clinton, those studios, are power stations. They’re all…
